[Highlight start] It is generally not recommended to mix **Aleve (naproxen)** and alcohol [Highlight end] . Both irritate the stomach lining, and combining them raises the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding, ulcers, and liver or kidney strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXX1R7Flwq29GDtet0IxzbneyKvJZq1_joFo2r-NpIpydvkcFtECtjiTFWxRitSZeg4qQrVAHM86Psre38QZm0nEME1cLaea1ou4oIuOqJrEZCG9HSHdRH1CaHdbE5E7TUWACDJ6-38qZJb4oSXgJscnyN6mTdj6F8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXUoq0ajCcoRJFrzRfn63UbTosioVxeNHZqoyCB_9Gp0rPGm1xLv4fTQfcl-LMgnDpl7kfR7ZOUAECLZVpAApeDnTjl4A0ixPDCHLuT5eQDQEoNdQ_zNWWWWIS--exFzMwWOJKO3Mm7mvA2Gf4z9G7TrNDTy8oEWW4Cw)

### Main Risks

- **Stomach irritation and bleeding:** Naproxen is an NSAID that reduces protective stomach prostaglandins, while alcohol directly irritates the digestive tract. Together, they increase the chance of gastritis, ulcers, and stomach bleeding.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXO0QzBiLvFxkjLqrWEnlfGV99wZnj1TIgxKIvgFI2U4e1g_qfh38yAPw4JRdrdVRS2w7I1m_0TKXrV1xFR0R4Jd7ekLxOfdDTMblmwExsPKt03widtW1rMf1sLCO1LLwK_NPZD7EpIMIx7t157MbmK1E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXUoq0ajCcoRJFrzRfn63UbTosioVxeNHZqoyCB_9Gp0rPGm1xLv4fTQfcl-LMgnDpl7kfR7ZOUAECLZVpAApeDnTjl4A0ixPDCHLuT5eQDQEoNdQ_zNWWWWIS--exFzMwWOJKO3Mm7mvA2Gf4z9G7TrNDTy8oEWW4Cw)
- **Higher risk with heavy use or older age:** Frequent or heavy drinking, taking higher-than-directed doses of Aleve, or being over age 60 increases the risk of severe GI and organ complications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXO0QzBiLvFxkjLqrWEnlfGV99wZnj1TIgxKIvgFI2U4e1g_qfh38yAPw4JRdrdVRS2w7I1m_0TKXrV1xFR0R4Jd7ekLxOfdDTMblmwExsPKt03widtW1rMf1sLCO1LLwK_NPZD7EpIMIx7t157MbmK1E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXUoq0ajCcoRJFrzRfn63UbTosioVxeNHZqoyCB_9Gp0rPGm1xLv4fTQfcl-LMgnDpl7kfR7ZOUAECLZVpAApeDnTjl4A0ixPDCHLuT5eQDQEoNdQ_zNWWWWIS--exFzMwWOJKO3Mm7mvA2Gf4z9G7TrNDTy8oEWW4Cw)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF16Giu0x6cGkJK-SEYHcf1jPK0gdbCvXLzegm-agcBX6GaqttmE3mS4Xixq1zWkRBmejjvah5RivtDwRBH8DjzUGFNwOghSeydBm-9LC5IKPAN-4F1yjvC837Pz3FIbU0FdE4U0d0YaZeRrejfMnSeZjzp_XtO7hj2XDXPX5IimKq6Pew)
- **Organ strain:** Combining them can add stress to the liver and kidneys.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXUoq0ajCcoRJFrzRfn63UbTosioVxeNHZqoyCB_9Gp0rPGm1xLv4fTQfcl-LMgnDpl7kfR7ZOUAECLZVpAApeDnTjl4A0ixPDCHLuT5eQDQEoNdQ_zNWWWWIS--exFzMwWOJKO3Mm7mvA2Gf4z9G7TrNDTy8oEWW4Cw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF16Giu0x6cGkJK-SEYHcf1jPK0gdbCvXLzegm-agcBX6GaqttmE3mS4Xixq1zWkRBmejjvah5RivtDwRBH8DjzUGFNwOghSeydBm-9LC5IKPAN-4F1yjvC837Pz3FIbU0FdE4U0d0YaZeRrejfMnSeZjzp_XtO7hj2XDXPX5IimKq6Pew)

### Practical Precautions

- **Check with a doctor or pharmacist:** Ask a healthcare provider before combining them, especially if you have a history of ulcers, stomach bleeding, high blood pressure, liver issues, or kidney problems. Guidance on alcohol and naproxen varies depending on your health history and how much you drink, so [Drugs.com](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXs7JKqqghp7Nu31C8vb4lZ8Pyh_oWIaMjFqcmDxkwc8XFFVeFON14AKy4aleW5ScXMysUFQmGAivwngobVEVwObTR8O6tQMUBtMs-WxFXyzdlXnPktKBeYpOGs6k78s01fJz77TVEOoIKN7dAb1RCmMk) advises checking with your doctor and [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXO0QzBiLvFxkjLqrWEnlfGV99wZnj1TIgxKIvgFI2U4e1g_qfh38yAPw4JRdrdVRS2w7I1m_0TKXrV1xFR0R4Jd7ekLxOfdDTMblmwExsPKt03widtW1rMf1sLCO1LLwK_NPZD7EpIMIx7t157MbmK1E) outlines risk factors and safety precautions.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXs7JKqqghp7Nu31C8vb4lZ8Pyh_oWIaMjFqcmDxkwc8XFFVeFON14AKy4aleW5ScXMysUFQmGAivwngobVEVwObTR8O6tQMUBtMs-WxFXyzdlXnPktKBeYpOGs6k78s01fJz77TVEOoIKN7dAb1RCmMk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXO0QzBiLvFxkjLqrWEnlfGV99wZnj1TIgxKIvgFI2U4e1g_qfh38yAPw4JRdrdVRS2w7I1m_0TKXrV1xFR0R4Jd7ekLxOfdDTMblmwExsPKt03widtW1rMf1sLCO1LLwK_NPZD7EpIMIx7t157MbmK1E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF16Giu0x6cGkJK-SEYHcf1jPK0gdbCvXLzegm-agcBX6GaqttmE3mS4Xixq1zWkRBmejjvah5RivtDwRBH8DjzUGFNwOghSeydBm-9LC5IKPAN-4F1yjvC837Pz3FIbU0FdE4U0d0YaZeRrejfMnSeZjzp_XtO7hj2XDXPX5IimKq6Pew)
- **Mind the timing:** Naproxen has a half-life of about 12 to 17 hours and takes roughly 3 to 4 days to clear completely, so people who choose to drink after taking it often wait at least 12 to 24 hours.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXUoq0ajCcoRJFrzRfn63UbTosioVxeNHZqoyCB_9Gp0rPGm1xLv4fTQfcl-LMgnDpl7kfR7ZOUAECLZVpAApeDnTjl4A0ixPDCHLuT5eQDQEoNdQ_zNWWWWIS--exFzMwWOJKO3Mm7mvA2Gf4z9G7TrNDTy8oEWW4Cw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF16Giu0x6cGkJK-SEYHcf1jPK0gdbCvXLzegm-agcBX6GaqttmE3mS4Xixq1zWkRBmejjvah5RivtDwRBH8DjzUGFNwOghSeydBm-9LC5IKPAN-4F1yjvC837Pz3FIbU0FdE4U0d0YaZeRrejfMnSeZjzp_XtO7hj2XDXPX5IimKq6Pew)

### When to Seek Immediate Care
Get urgent medical help if you experience warning signs of stomach or intestinal bleeding, such as:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXO0QzBiLvFxkjLqrWEnlfGV99wZnj1TIgxKIvgFI2U4e1g_qfh38yAPw4JRdrdVRS2w7I1m_0TKXrV1xFR0R4Jd7ekLxOfdDTMblmwExsPKt03widtW1rMf1sLCO1LLwK_NPZD7EpIMIx7t157MbmK1E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXs7JKqqghp7Nu31C8vb4lZ8Pyh_oWIaMjFqcmDxkwc8XFFVeFON14AKy4aleW5ScXMysUFQmGAivwngobVEVwObTR8O6tQMUBtMs-WxFXyzdlXnPktKBeYpOGs6k78s01fJz77TVEOoIKN7dAb1RCmMk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF16Giu0x6cGkJK-SEYHcf1jPK0gdbCvXLzegm-agcBX6GaqttmE3mS4Xixq1zWkRBmejjvah5RivtDwRBH8DjzUGFNwOghSeydBm-9LC5IKPAN-4F1yjvC837Pz3FIbU0FdE4U0d0YaZeRrejfMnSeZjzp_XtO7hj2XDXPX5IimKq6Pew)

- Black, tarry, or bloody stools
- Vomiting blood or material that looks like coffee grounds
- Severe or persistent stomach pain, or feeling faint or lightheaded[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXO0QzBiLvFxkjLqrWEnlfGV99wZnj1TIgxKIvgFI2U4e1g_qfh38yAPw4JRdrdVRS2w7I1m_0TKXrV1xFR0R4Jd7ekLxOfdDTMblmwExsPKt03widtW1rMf1sLCO1LLwK_NPZD7EpIMIx7t157MbmK1E)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXs7JKqqghp7Nu31C8vb4lZ8Pyh_oWIaMjFqcmDxkwc8XFFVeFON14AKy4aleW5ScXMysUFQmGAivwngobVEVwObTR8O6tQMUBtMs-WxFXyzdlXnPktKBeYpOGs6k78s01fJz77TVEOoIKN7dAb1RCmMk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF16Giu0x6cGkJK-SEYHcf1jPK0gdbCvXLzegm-agcBX6GaqttmE3mS4Xixq1zWkRBmejjvah5RivtDwRBH8DjzUGFNwOghSeydBm-9LC5IKPAN-4F1yjvC837Pz3FIbU0FdE4U0d0YaZeRrejfMnSeZjzp_XtO7hj2XDXPX5IimKq6Pew)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXUoq0ajCcoRJFrzRfn63UbTosioVxeNHZqoyCB_9Gp0rPGm1xLv4fTQfcl-LMgnDpl7kfR7ZOUAECLZVpAApeDnTjl4A0ixPDCHLuT5eQDQEoNdQ_zNWWWWIS--exFzMwWOJKO3Mm7mvA2Gf4z9G7TrNDTy8oEWW4Cw)
